zh: 平坦、暗能量主导：和我们的宇宙是近亲。
en: Flat and dark-energy dominated: a close relative of our universe.

zh: 封闭、物质过多：注定大坍缩。
en: Closed, too much matter: doomed to a Big Crunch.

zh: 开放、物质稀薄：近乎匀速膨胀到永远。
en: Open and thinly populated: coasting at almost constant speed forever.

zh: 爱因斯坦–德西特：平坦、只有物质、减速膨胀到永远。
en: Einstein–de Sitter: flat, matter only, decelerating forever.

zh: 封闭却在加速：Λ 赢过了曲率。
en: Closed yet accelerating: Λ beat the curvature.

zh: 开放、现在还在减速，但那点 Λ 终将接管并加速。
en: Open and still decelerating now, but that little Λ will eventually take over and accelerate it.
